channel.title: Andalusia Star News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Andalusia Star News (andalusiastarnews.com)

item.title: OCS’ Edgar announces retirement
item.description: Opp City Schools Superintendent Emily Edgar will retire June 1, closing a 37-year career with the system she joined at 19 and calling the superintendent role her career pinnacle.

item.title: CHRIST TOOK THE PUNISHMENT FOR OUR SINS
item.description: Chuck Colson’s Prison Fellowship shares how a Brazilian prison was transformed, pointing to Christ who took the punishment for our sins so anyone can be forgiven.

item.title: City of Andy approves budget, ABC license
item.description: Andalusia council adds $481,770 for high school upgrades, approves Off the Trax special-events ABC license, and begins process to surplus a former Salvation Army site.

item.title: Revive Worship and FBC Gantt hold Youth Revival
item.description: FBC Gantt hosted its first Youth Revival as Revive Worship and speaker Caleb Bell brought together over 100 students from area youth groups for a Christ-centered night.

item.title: NEW FACES IN LBW’S PTK
item.description: LBW’s Phi Theta Kappa chapter inducted 43 students on March 16, honoring academic excellence, rising membership and research projects serving campus and community.

item.title: Navy Workforce Investment benefits LBW
item.description: A $30 million U.S. Navy investment will expand maritime training at four Alabama community colleges, positioning LBW and its partners to supply high-demand submarine and shipbuilding workers.

item.title: CAC is riding, roping and raising awareness
item.description: Cowboys for Kids Rodeo draws 90 contestants and support from 80+ local sponsors, raising funds for Covington County’s Child Advocacy Center and April child abuse awareness events.

item.title: Andalusia Public Library celebrates Post to Page
item.description: Andalusia Public Library marked the 100th anniversary of its former post office home with a Post to Page reception, highlighting the building’s history and the library’s historic success.

item.title: Statement in Opposition to the Proposed Pine Hills Storage Hub Project
item.description: Clint Grantham urges Coffee County to oppose Pine Hills carbon storage hub, citing aquifer risks, EPA permit concerns and mounting regional opposition.

item.title: Jearldene “Jerri” Stroud Obituary
item.description: Jearldene “Jerri” Stroud, 90, longtime Andalusia educator and community servant, died April 2, 2026; services April 4 at First Baptist Church Andalusia.

item.title: NASA ASTRONAUTS TO ORBIT THE FAR SIDE OF THE MOON
item.description: NASA's Artemis II launches four astronauts on a record-distance journey 4,600 miles beyond the Moon's far side, linking past missions with reflections on Jesus' mission to seek and save the lost.

item.title: A SLITHERING 65TH RODEO
item.description: Opp’s 65th Rattlesnake Rodeo draws record crowds and about 170 vendors with concerts, snake races and strong sponsor support, as planning begins for next year’s event.

item.title: Jail Report from March 31 to April 2
item.description: See who was booked March 31–April 2: Covington County jail report details arrests on DUI, drug, domestic violence, probation and failure-to-appear charges.

item.title: City of Andalusia holds Comprehensive Plan Meeting
item.description: Andalusia gathers more than 150 residents to shape its Comprehensive Plan, setting goals for transportation, neighborhoods, resilience, recreation and tourism.

item.title: Saturday | April 4, 2026 E-edition
item.description: Explore the full digital version of our April 4, 2026 issue and stay updated with the latest news and features.
